# Runtime keys in .grove.toml affect commands without git config
setup_workspace

cp $WORK/grove.toml .grove.toml

# plain and debug apply from TOML
exec grove list --fast --verbose
stdout '^\*'
stdout '^    > path:'
stderr '\[DEBUG\]'

# Flags override TOML, while nerd_fonts=false keeps ASCII icons
exec grove list --fast --verbose --plain=false --debug=false
stdout '^\*'
stdout '^    ↳ path:'
! stdout '●'
! stderr '\[DEBUG\]'

# autolock.patterns applies from TOML without git config
! exec git config --get-all grove.autoLock
exec grove add release/x
stderr 'Created worktree at .*[/\\]release-x'
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare worktree list --porcelain
stdout '(?s)worktree .*[/\\]release-x\nHEAD .*\nbranch refs/heads/release/x\nlocked'

# stale_threshold supplies the value for --stale=
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo checkout -b feature-stale-config
exec sh -c 'cd $WORK/testrepo && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="2024-01-01T00:00:00" GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="2024-01-01T00:00:00" git commit --allow-empty -m "old commit"'
exec git -C $WORK/testrepo checkout main
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare fetch origin
exec grove add feature-stale-config
exec grove prune --stale=
stderr 'No worktrees to prune'

-- grove.toml --
nerd_fonts = false
stale_threshold = "9999d"
plain = true
debug = true

[autolock]
patterns = ["release/*"]
